def: properly, length, i.e. a measure (of uncertain dimension)

words.word: yet there was but a little

occurrences.text: And they journeyed from Beth–el; and there was but a little way to come to Ephrath: and Rachel travailed, and she had hard labour.

And as for me, when I came from Padan, Rachel died by me in the land of Canaan in the way, when yet there was but a little way to come unto Ephrath: and I buried her there in the way of Ephrath; the same is Beth–lehem.
words: yet there was but a little

occurrences.text: And he said unto him, Go in peace. So he departed from him a little way.
